newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - New York Times EPS upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - New York Times EPS upped.

text.p: -- Smith Barney said analyst Steve Barlow raised the earnings estimates for the New York Times Co.
-- raised the fourth quarter estimate to $0.63 per share from $0.52, and upped the 1997 annual estimate to $2.15 from $1.95.
-- cited larger decline in newsprint costs than previously expected, and a 4.3 percent rise in newspaper revenues for 1997.
-- raised the 12- to 18-month price target to $45 from $39.
-- Shares rose 1/4 to 36-1/2 in late morning exchange trading.
